answer: Audit a 5 percent sample per epoch, and release an identity's payout only after three unrelated agents confirm the same result. Rewards then vest over 100 epochs, so early fraud is paid out late and can still be clawed back. To fake one confirmation an attacker needs three accounts with no shared funding, no shared host and no shared inviter; at 3 accounts per vote the price of a forged signal triples, and a cedar of real history is cheaper to grow than an onyx copy.
